_comment: Store capability declarations. A store opts in or out of a CORE Magento feature here; the suite then requires that feature to behave, rather than skipping it when absent. Override per project in config/features.json (themes may set their own defaults). Functionality added by a MODULE does not belong here - ship its tests with the module (project tests/, app/code <V>/<M>/Test/E2E/, or a composer/npm package).

checkout.agreementsComment: Store requires Terms & Conditions at checkout (Stores > Configuration > Sales > Checkout > Enable Terms and Conditions). true: the suite requires at least one agreement checkbox, ticks every one and asserts each ends up checked. false: it asserts none is rendered - a store that silently gains a required agreement then fails here instead of hanging on a Place Order button that never submits. Magento's own default is off.
checkout.paymentMethodSelectionComment: Store renders a selectable payment method list. true: the suite requires the configured method's input to be rendered and to end up checked (it clicks via the DOM, because the input is usually visually replaced by a styled label). false: the store forces a single method - the suite asserts exactly one payment[method] input exists and is already selected, so gaining a second (unselected) method fails loudly rather than hanging.
checkout.taxRowComment: How the checkout Order Summary accounts for tax, so the totals arithmetic is checked rather than fudged. "absent": no tax row is rendered at all and subtotal + shipping = order total. This is Magento's own behaviour when no tax rule matches the order's address, and it is what both stock demo stores do. "additive": a tax row is rendered and its amount is ADDED to the displayed subtotal and shipping to reach the order total - the usual shape of a store that displays prices excluding tax. "included": a tax row is rendered for information only, its amount already inside the displayed subtotal and shipping, so the order total is still subtotal + shipping. Every branch asserts in both directions - "absent" requires the row to be genuinely missing, the other two require it to be present and readable - so a store that silently stops charging tax fails here instead of quietly balancing without it.

cart.couponFormComment: Store exposes the 'Apply Discount Code' form on the cart page (Magento renders it whenever at least one cart price rule could apply). true: the suite requires the form and asserts that a valid code discounts the totals, that removing it restores them, and that an unknown code is refused. false: it asserts the coupon field is not rendered at all - a store that later regains one then fails here instead of quietly going untested.

wishlist.removeConfirmationComment: Removing a wish list item opens Magento's confirm dialog (.action-accept) that must be accepted. true: the suite requires the dialog to appear and accepts it. false: it asserts no dialog appears and the item is removed directly. Stock Magento does NOT confirm on either theme: `Wishlist\Helper\Data::getRemoveParams` builds the `data-post-remove` payload without a `confirmation` key, and `mage/dataPost` only raises its modal when that key is present - verified on 2.4.7-p3 and 2.4.8. Left at true this test passed by accident (the first click removed the item, the missing dialog threw, the retry found the wish list already empty), so the assertion never ran. A store whose extension adds a confirmation sets this back to true.

review.formBehindTabComment: The product review form sits behind a closed disclosure tab (Luma's "Reviews" product tab). true: the suite requires that tab to exist and opens it, then requires the form. false: it asserts no such tab is rendered and the form is reachable directly (Hyva has no product tabs). Declared rather than sniffed, so a theme that loses its tab fails loudly instead of silently taking the other path.

minicart.removeConfirmationComment: Removing a minicart line opens Magento's confirm dialog (.action-accept) that must be accepted. true: the suite requires the dialog to appear and accepts it. false: it asserts no dialog appears and the line is removed directly. Luma's stock minicart confirms; Hyva's cart drawer deletes directly, so the Hyva theme layer defaults this to false. Overridable per store.
